parameters.content:
# AI Company Intelligence Agent

Give the workflow a company name + official website. The agent autonomously navigates the website using two tools, finds relevant pages such as About, Products, Technology and Careers, and produces an evidence-oriented structured company intelligence report.

Built as a personal n8n agentic automation project.

### Input

Change the four values below before running:
- Company name
- Official website
- Research objective
- Target role/domain

No original template credentials are included.

assignments.name: research_objective
assignments.value: Understand the company's business, products, technology, AI usage, customers, hiring and career opportunities.

assignments.name: target_role
assignments.value: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer / AI Engineer

parameters.text: =Research {{ $json.company_name }} using its official website {{ $json.company_website }}. Research objective: {{ $json.research_objective }} Target role/domain: {{ $json.target_role }}

options.systemMessage: You are an autonomous company intelligence research agent. Your job is to investigate a company starting from its official website. Use the website text tool to read pages and the website URL tool to discover links. Navigate relevant pages such as About, Products, Solutions, Technology, AI, Blog, News, Customers, Careers, Jobs, Team and Contact when available. Do not blindly crawl every link: prioritize pages relevant to the research objective. You may follow several relevant pages before producing the report. Use only information actually retrieved from the website or linked pages. Do not invent facts. If information cannot be verified, return an empty value and put the issue in limitations. Treat competitor information carefully: only include competitors or alternatives when the retrieved company material provides enough evidence; otherwise leave the array empty. For hiring information, prioritize official careers/job pages. For every key page, preserve the URL that was actually retrieved. The final answer must be structured according to the JSON parser schema.
